entry.title: The Presidential Memo on Combating Transnational Cybercrime: Implications for Industry and Government
entry.content: The Trump administration has directed the private sector to conduct offensive cyber operations in cyberspace. But much will depend on its implementation and ensuring clear alignment with private sector risk appetites.
